concern_summary: Functionality concerning the management of private notes, allowing users to retrieve, edit, and display their private notes while handling various states including drafts and errors.

This concern focuses on the management and integration of accounting-related functionalities, allowing users to configure and synchronize accounts and tax posting procedures in relation to private notes.
This concern involves managing the scrolling behavior of lists, including tracking the last scroll position, restoring it upon focus, and ensuring specific items remain in view during updates.
Functionality related to managing private notes, including editing, saving, and updating notes, ensuring changes are preserved and retrievable.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to displaying and managing various types of pages involved in money requests, including interactions for requesting, processing, and viewing transaction receipts and the associated states during these processes.

This concern addresses the rendering and styling of text elements within various contexts, ensuring that the text displays correctly with appropriate styling, accessibility features, and responsiveness to context changes in the UI.
Management and retrieval of introductory text related to free trial offers, ensuring appropriate display based on user subscription status.
This concern involves validating and managing user input for personal identification, specifically focusing on legal and display names through dedicated pages.
This concern groups functionalities that handle user interactions and settings related to receipt requirements for reimbursements and subscriptions.
